a/blackrock-etf

BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded net inflows of $1.2 billion on Monday, according to data from Farside Investors, marking the largest single-day intake in three months.

The inflows came as bitcoin climbed above $98,000 for the first time in several weeks, with traders pointing to expectations of further interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve.

Total net inflows into U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs reached $1.9 billion for the day, with Fidelity's FBTC adding $310 million. Analysts at the firm said institutional demand remained strong heading into the end of the year.
